sources.quote: Drip pricing is an enforcement priority and penalties can reach the greater of $10 million or three times the benefit derived
sources.title: Penalties and remedies for non-compliance
sources.evidence: For corporations, the penalty for a first-time violation related to false or misleading representations is up to the greater of: $10 million ($15 million for each subsequent violation); and three times the value of the benefit derived from the deceptive conduct, or, if that amount cannot be reasonably determined, 3% of the corporation's annual worldwide gross revenue.

sources.quote: its Influencer Marketing Disclosure Guidelines, updated October 2025, require material connections disclosed in the caption or as a tag, not in hashtags
sources.title: Influencer Marketing Disclosure Guidelines
sources.evidence: Guidelines PDF dated 2025-10-08. Using .ad at the end of a list of hashtags is not effective disclosure; #ad, when buried in a hashtag list, does not make the disclosure clear and conspicuous. Disclosure must be clear, prominent, and in close proximity to the representation being made.

sources.quote: gives the consumer ten days to cancel after receiving the contract
sources.publisher: Office de la protection du consommateur (Quebec)
sources.title: Cancelling a Purchase Made From an Itinerant Salesperson
sources.evidence: Under section 58 of the Consumer Protection Act, you may cancel a contract with an itinerant merchant for any reason within 10 days after you receive a copy of the contract along with the other required documents. The 10-day deadline starts the day after you receive your copy of the signed contract.

sources.quote: The Consumer Protection Act, 2023 received Royal Assent in December 2023
sources.title: Bill 142, Better for Consumers, Better for Businesses Act, 2023 - Legislative Assembly of Ontario
sources.evidence: Bill 142 is An Act to enact the Consumer Protection Act, 2023, to amend the Consumer Reporting Act and to amend or repeal various other Acts and received Royal Assent as Chapter 23 of the Statutes of Ontario 2023; Royal Assent was announced on Monday, December 4, 2023.

sources.quote: roughly $9.25 to $39.33 per event without dancing and $18.51 to $78.66 with dancing, by room capacity
sources.publisher: University of British Columbia (Copyright at UBC)
sources.title: Information about SOCAN and Re:Sound Fees at UBC | Copyright at UBC
sources.evidence: Re:Sound Tariff No. 5B – Receptions, Conventions, Assemblies and Fashion Shows is a per-event and per-day fee and ranges from $9.25 to $39.33 (without dancing) and $18.51 to $78.66 (with dancing), based on room capacity (seating and standing).

sources.quote: with further provisions in effect since June 1, 2025 and the OQLF handling complaints
sources.title: Entrée en vigueur, le 1er juin 2025, de nouvelles obligations en matière d’affichage prévues à la Charte de la langue française
sources.evidence: New measures entered into force on June 1, 2025, including new obligations regarding commercial signage, trademarks on products, and business francization. Public signage and commercial advertising must ensure the markedly predominant presence of French.

sources.quote: South Asian Canadians are about 19 percent of the Greater Toronto Area population in the 2021 Census
sources.title: Focus on Geography Series, 2021 Census - Toronto (Census metropolitan area)
sources.evidence: In 2021, the largest racialized group in the Toronto census metropolitan area was South Asian, with about 1,182,480 persons representing 19.2% of the total population.

sources.quote: the largest visible-minority group in Brampton and Mississauga
sources.title: Focus on Geography Series, 2021 Census - Brampton (Census subdivision)
sources.evidence: Brampton: In 2021, the largest racialized group was South Asian, with about 340,815 persons representing 52.4% of the total population. Mississauga: the largest racialized group was South Asian, with about 180,800 persons representing 25.4% of the total population.

sources.quote: Gartner's 2025 CMO Spend Survey puts marketing at roughly 7.7 percent of revenue across industries
sources.title: Gartner 2025 CMO Spend Survey Reveals Marketing Budgets Have Flatlined at 7.7% of Overall Company Revenue
sources.evidence: CMOs report that their marketing budgets for 2025 remain flat at 7.7% of overall company revenue, according to a survey by Gartner, Inc. The survey was conducted February through March 2025 among 402 CMOs and other marketing leaders in North America, the United Kingdom and Europe.

flags.quote: Receptions require SOCAN Tariff 8 and Re:Sound Tariff 5.B through Entandem, roughly $9.25 to $39.33 per event without dancing
flags.issue: The $9.25 to $39.33 / $18.51 to $78.66 ranges are the Re:Sound Tariff 5.B fees only. SOCAN Tariff 8 is a separate per-event fee of $22.06 to $93.78 without dancing and $44.13 to $187.55 with dancing, so the combined cost of both licences is roughly three to four times the figure the article gives.
